en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.792 - Ismail ibn Isa asked Abu Al-Hasan al-Ridha

about leather and fur items purchased from a market in the mountain regions: Should a person inquire about their source of slaughter (i.e., whether it was properly done) if the seller is a Muslim but not a known believer?
He (as) replied: "You should inquire if you see that the sellers are polytheists selling those items. But if you see them performing prayer, then you do not need to ask”.
